\begin{align*}
y^2 &= (2 \sin t \cos t)^2 \\
&= 4 \sin^2 t \cos^2 t \\
&= 4x^2 (1 - x^2) \\
&= 4x^2 - 4x^4.
\end{align*}Thus,
\[4x^4 - 4x^2 + y^2 = 0,\]so the smallest possible value of $a + b + c$ is $4 + 4 + 1 = \boxed{9}.$
